ctx.x: Yeah. I'm pretty sure, at that time, because -- wait a minute now. I've got to check back from the time that Fletcher was living because Fletcher was on this, and I think we talked about this earlier when we had jam sessions, we would fly Benny -- Benny Carter out to play

and Henry Armstrong, the prize fighter would come through, and Billy Eckstine would come through, and he did a stint there for us. We'd pay them, and they would make an appearance, and this is the time, I think, that I had Duke Ellington's band come out. They couldn't play, but we had fried chicken out there in the middle of the floor. They signed autographs for the people.
Uh-huh. I know we were talking about that. I can't remember whether we put that on tape or if that was just one of our --
